newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece sets coupons on 5/7-yr bonds at 9.2/8.9pct. [CORRECTED 13:42 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Greece sets coupons on 5/7-yr bonds at 9.2/8.9pct. [CORRECTED 13:42 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects to reverse order of coupon rates in title.)

Greece's finance ministry set coupons of three-, five- and seven-year bonds at 9.8 percent (corrects from 8.9 percent), 9.2 percent and 8.9 percent (corrects from 9.8 percent) respectively, it said in a statement.
The ministry will auction 150 billion drachmas of three-year bonds, 100 billion of five-year bonds and 50 billion of seven-year bonds on March 19.
Issue date is March 21, it added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
